semantic_slots.objects: mu=Z^{-1}exp(-V) volume on R^d; actual pi_eta joint law with Y=X+sqrt(eta)Z and outer marginal nu=pi_eta^Y. H=L2(pi_eta), P conditional expectation given Y, H_P=ran P identified with L2(nu), H_perp=ker P. U is the joint reflection pullback f(x,2x-y); T=U_PP is a selfadjoint contraction on H_P; B=U_perpP maps H_P to H_perp. Gamma_P=(I-T^2)^{1/2} on H_P.
semantic_slots.domains: Joint and outer norms are actual weighted L2 quotient norms; vector-gradient norm is weighted L2(nu). Smooth proof input is signed C_c^infinity(R^d); printed B.13 input is every L2(nu) class, whose T-image lies in H1(nu). Rough gradient is a weak/closed-domain object, never a totalized classical gradient of an arbitrary AE representative. Gamma acts on macro H_P, potentially infinite dimensional, not on spatial R^d.
